label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter name flows directly into bar via Base64 round-trip which preserves content, then bar is used as an argument to Writer.format() alongside a fixed array containing 'a','b'. Since format strings are constructed from arguments, attackers can inject '%n%n%s' into the parameter name to trigger arbitrary code execution/format string vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Parameter name extracted from request, encoded/decoded preserving content, passed to format() sink allowing format string attacks
Sink: response.getWriter().format(bar, obj) uses tainted variable as format specifier
